## CASE FACT SUMMARY

### Document Summary
This is a Complaint filed in the District Court of Caldwell County, State of Thornfield, Case No. CV-2024-08847, brought by Synthex Industrial Partners Inc. against Norwood Fabrication Group LLC and Gerald P. Norwood individually, alleging breach of contract, fraud, and unjust enrichment. The complaint was filed on March 14, 2024, and seeks damages totaling $680,000.00 (compensatory plus punitive). The plaintiff is represented by Kavanaugh & Ashworth LLP [E1].
